label: rem:strangelet-double-beta-minimal-path
title: Minimal Skein-descent path from the cinquefoil to the trefoil
html: The interaction products of prop:strangelet-double-beta become electromagnetically visible only through Skein crossing changes. Each crossing change is a beta decay that lowers the degree from 2 toward 1. The minimal path from the degree-2 fiber (cinquefoil, 5 crossings) to the degree-1 fiber (trefoil, 3 crossings) requires two crossing changes: a double beta decay.
